items.title: On a genus 0 proper curve an invertible sheaf of positive degree d has d+1 sections, vanishing H^1, and embeds X into P^d
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the complete section behaviour of a positive-degree sheaf on a genus 0 curve (statement lines 2018-2028). The proof (lines 2030-2105) is an honest computation: the Cartier divisor sequence attached to a section, the triviality of L|_D over the Artinian zero scheme, the vanishing of H^1, the surjectivity of the multiplication maps proved by dividing sections along D, and the final Proj comparison producing the embedding. H2: all ingredients are standard, but the division-of-sections step and the graded-algebra bookkeeping must be done in the right order.
